description: List the latest advisories across every tracked stack, newest first, without a package list. Filter by sector (js, stack, ai, crypto) and severity; by default the last 7 days and at most 20 advisories (days 1 to 30, limit 1 to 50). An empty list means nothing matched. To check your own packages, use get_advisories instead.

days.description: How many days back, from 1 to 30. Default 7.

limit.description: How many advisories at most, from 1 to 50. Default 20.

section.description: Sector: js (JS runtimes and frameworks), stack (hosting and data platforms), ai (AI SDKs and agent tools), crypto (web3 libraries). Omit for every sector.

severity.description: Only this severity; watch is an announced change or upcoming fix. Omit for all.

name: list_feed
title: Latest advisories
